name: Vault 13: Dweller's Journey
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — For each player, exile up to one other target enchantment or creature that player controls until this Saga leaves the battlefield.
II — You gain 2 life and scry 2.
III — Return two cards exiled with this Saga to the battlefield under their owners' control and put the rest on the bottom of their owners' libraries.
blocked_sentences: III — Return two cards exiled with this Saga to the battlefield under their owners' control and put the rest on the bottom of their owners' libraries.

needs.what: an op that has the controller choose exactly N cards (N fixed, all if fewer) from the cards exiled with the source (exiled_with: self, owned by any player), puts the chosen ones onto the battlefield under their owners' control, and puts every unchosen one on the bottom of its owner's library
needs.why_existing_wont_do: put_onto_battlefield over {exiled_with: self} moves all of them with no choice; search_zones can read zones: [exile] but only pools the searching player's own zones (players[pid].zone_list), so cards owned by opponents are unreachable, and its pick is 0..count (up to), not exactly two; choose_permanents selects battlefield permanents, not exiled cards; put_on_top with bottom could send the rest down only if the chosen two had a binding to exclude, which nothing produces from the exile pile
